title: Polynomials Are Vectors Too
topic: A polynomial p(x) = a + b·x + c·x² is determined by three numbers — its coordinates in the basis {1, x, x²}. Scrub the (a, b, c) triple and watch both the coordinate vector and the polynomial graph update in sync. Adding two polynomials adds their coordinate triples component-by-component. Polynomials of degree at most two form a three-dimensional vector space.
